description: Generates a SQUARE wave - a pure generator with NO audio input (input_arity 0; call process() without an input argument). Submode 2 of the wave family (sibling submode 1 sine and 4 ramp are curated; 3 is a triangle despite the banner calling it 'sawtooth'). Shape verified numerically: +1 for the first half-cycle, -1 for the second, with one table-interpolated sample at each edge (cycle samples at 100 Hz: 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, -0.419, -1.0, -1.0, -1.0, -1.0). Output duration is set exactly by dur (2.0 -> 88200 frames, 0.7 -> 30870). Both frq and amp are breakpoint-capable (re-verified in this submode against both endpoint renders / the constant render), making it an envelope-controllable square oscillator. tabsize audibly matters here - the edge transition sharpens with a bigger table (-t4096 render differs from the 256 default, verified). Deterministic (identical runs byte-identical, 1.2 s apart). Peak amplitude at amp 1 is full scale - a square at amp 1 is the loudest signal CDP can emit (RMS = 0 dBFS); stage headroom.
musical_use: The hollow-clarinet buzz and the IDM sub-bass workhorse: odd-harmonic-only spectrum that reads as woody/hollow at mid frequencies and as a hard square sub below 100 Hz. As a test signal its odd-harmonic comb makes filter sweeps and spectral processes audible in a way the sine sibling cannot - feed it to filter bank or specfnu and every resonance rings. Time-varying frq gives PWM-less chiptune glides and sirens (relative envelope times map onto dur); time-varying amp shapes gates and swells without a second enveloping pass. NOTE the naive wavetable ALIASES: edges are only one interpolated sample wide, so above a few hundred Hz the foldover shimmer is audible - lean into it as digital grit, or keep frq low and tabsize high (4096) for the cleanest edge. Frequencies above Nyquist are accepted SILENTLY (aliasing verified at 12 kHz / 22.05 kHz srate). Hot at amp 1 (0 dBFS RMS); 0.3-0.5 is a saner mix level. Ring-modulate it (modify radical 5) for instant harsh bell clusters.

srate.description: Output sample rate - discrete set 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000 (re-verified in this submode: 11025 refused quoting the range '(16000.000000 to 192000.000000)', 192000 in-range but refused 'Invalid sample rate.'). Entry default 44100 - always emitted (positional).

chans.description: Output channel count, CDP-enforced 1 to 16 (17 refused quoting '(1.000000 to 16.000000)'; banner claims 1, 2 or 4). Multi-channel output is DUAL-MONO (channels bit-identical, re-verified stereo in this submode).

dur.description: Output duration in seconds - sets the output length exactly (sample-exact; 0.039 refused '(0.040000 to 7200.000000)'). The engine's own duration cap applies first via the set_by pre-flight. Required.

frq.description: Oscillator frequency in Hz. CDP-enforced 0.1 to 22000 REGARDLESS of sample rate (0.05 and 23000 refused quoting '(0.100000 to 22000.000000)'; 12 kHz at srate 22050 accepted silently and aliases - re-verified in this submode). Square-wave harmonics alias well below that - the advisory musical ceiling is much lower than the sine sibling's. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: a 220->880 envelope renders and differs from both endpoint renders); relative envelope times map onto dur. Entry default 440 (positional, always emitted).

amp.description: Output amplitude, CDP-enforced 0-1 (omitted = 1.0, full scale - verified: flag-less and -a1 byte-identical). CDP accepts -a0 but renders digital silence (-inf dBFS, verified in this submode) - curated min keeps it nonzero. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 0.001->1 ramp, first-100ms RMS 0.06 vs last-100ms 0.98). A full-scale square is 0 dBFS RMS - hotter than any other waveform; stage headroom.

tabsize.description: Size of the wavetable storing the waveform, CDP-enforced 256 to 4096 (-t3 and -t100000 refused quoting '(256.000000 to 4096.000000)'). Default 256 when omitted; rounded to a multiple of 4. MATTERS in this submode: -t4096 verified to change the render (sharper edge, different interpolation residue) - unlike sibling submode 4 where it is a no-op.

examples.description: A 2-second 110 Hz square bass tone at mix level.
examples.expected_use: No input argument. Odd-harmonic hollow bass; byte-identical on every render.
Two-decade square glide down; relative envelope times stretch over the full 3 s.

known_issues: Waveform submodes: 1 sine (curated), 2 square (this entry), 3 triangle (banner wrongly says 'sawtooth'), 4 descending ramp (curated). Shape verified numerically: half-cycle +1 / half-cycle -1 with a single interpolated sample at each edge.

ALIASING: the naive wavetable square has no band-limiting - harmonics fold at Nyquist and the shimmer is audible from a few hundred Hz up. frq's enforced ceiling is a flat 22000 Hz independent of srate and above-Nyquist fundamentals are accepted SILENTLY (verified 12 kHz at srate 22050). Treat aliasing as a feature or keep frq low.
A full-scale square (amp defaults to 1.0) is 0 dBFS RMS - the hottest signal in the synth family; summing it with anything clips (submix mix wraps). Curated musical_range tops at 0.6.
amp 0 is accepted by CDP but renders digital silence (fails output verification) - curated nonzero minimum.
Deterministic: no seed, no clock dependence; identical params render byte-identically (verified 1.2 s apart). Multi-channel output is dual-mono (channels bit-identical).
srate accepts only the discrete set 16000/22050/24000/32000/44100/48000/88200/96000 despite the quoted 16000-192000 range (both refusal styles re-verified in this submode).
Generator entry: process() takes no input argument here; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries with a structured arity_zero_unsupported error - render first, then wire the output.
